_note: Champions' stat and stacking passives, in the same stats/effects keys as augments (see README). Applied by tools/build_champion_pool.py. Values ending _l1/_l18 grow with level. Stacks that build up over a game use an assumed count at level 18, noted in `why`; damage passives live in passives.json, and stacks that only add to one ability's damage are `hit_adds` in champion_overrides.json (Nasus Q).

Veigar.why: Phenomenal Evil: 300 AP of stacks assumed by level 18

Senna.why: Absolution: 60 souls assumed by level 18 (0.75 AD each, 10% crit and 25 range per 20); her crits deal only 80% of the usual crit multiplier (CritDamageMod 0.8)

Thresh.why: Damnation: 70 souls assumed by level 18 (1 armor and 0.75 AP each)

Chogath.why: Feast: 6 stacks assumed by level 18 (80 Health each)

Sion.why: Soul Furnace: 500 Health of kill stacks assumed by level 18

Swain.why: Ravenous Flock: 300 Health of Soul Fragments assumed by level 18

Garen.why: Courage: full 30 Armor and Magic Resist stacks

Kayle.why: Divine Ascent: attacks from 525 range from level 6

Tryndamere.why: Battle Fury: 0.4% crit per Fury, about 60 Fury on average

Belveth.why: Death in Lavender: 50% attack speed of permanent stacks assumed by level 18; ability hits grant 20% attack speed for 3s

Ezreal.why: Rising Spell Force: 10% attack speed per ability hit, up to 5

Jinx.why: Switcheroo! minigun: Rev'd up attack speed per attack, up to 3 (130% at max rank)

Jax.why: Relentless Assault: 3.5-11% attack speed per attack (by level), up to 8

Irelia.why: Ionian Fervor: attack speed per ability hit, up to 4 (approximate per-stack values)

Yasuo.why: Way of the Wanderer: double crit chance, crits deal 10% less

Yone.why: Way of the Hunter: double crit chance, crits deal 10% less

Jhin.why: Whisper: fixed 0.625 attack speed, every fourth shot crits, crits deal 14% less; 4-44% bonus AD by level plus 0.35% per 1% crit and 0.3% per 1% bonus attack speed; reloads for 2.5s after the fourth shot

Aatrox.why: Umbral Dash: Aatrox heals for about 20% of the damage he deals to champions

Singed.why: Insanity Potion (R, rank 3): +85 AP, armor, magic resist and move speed for 25s, cast at the start of each fight

Karma.why: Gathering Fire: each damage instance on a champion takes 4s off Mantra's cooldown

Rammus.why: Spiked Shell: bonus AD equal to 15% total armor + 15% total magic resist

Zac.why: Goo: each ability that hits drops a chunk; picking it up takes 1s off Unstable Matter

Olaf.why: Berserker Rage: up to 100% bonus attack speed and 25% life steal at level 18, growing with missing Health (full at 70% missing); Ragnarok passive: 20 bonus armor and magic resist

Zaahen.why: Determination: a stack per hit on a champion (5s, up to 12), each 1.5-2.8% AD, doubled at 12 stacks (about 15 AD a stack at 18 counting the doubling evenly); Grim Deliverance passive: 30% armor penetration

Hecarim.why: Warpath: 12-24% of bonus movement speed as bonus AD; the 45 from boots assumed
